Seek Christ with us

Find your faith in your own way. We are here to walk with you on your spiritual journey.

I want to know more Our services

Spain Barcelona Mission

We are volunteer missionaries of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints serving in Spain.

We dedicate our time to serving the community, sharing a message of hope and helping those who want to strengthen their relationship with God.

All of our services are completely free. It doesn't matter where you are from, your culture or your language — you are welcome.

Talk to us

What we offer

All our services are free, offered by volunteers who want to share what has given them peace and purpose.

Visit our church

Come to our Sunday service, no strings attached. Feel peace and draw closer to God: you can stay as long as you like and no one will ask anything of you.

Learn more →

Scripture Study

Learn the Book of Mormon and the Bible with us in an atmosphere of respect and love. Two testaments, one Christ.

Learn more →

Family History

Discover your roots and connect with your ancestors. We help you for free with FamilySearch.

Learn more →

English and Spanish Classes

Learn English or Spanish for free with our missionaries. Practical, fun classes for all levels.

Support and Well-being

Emotional support and recovery programs. You are not alone — we are here to walk with you through difficult times.

Learn more →

Family Home Evenings

Weekly activities to make friends, play, learn and enjoy a community that welcomes you with open arms.

Learn more →

Community Service

Join our community service projects. Together we can make a real difference.

Institute

Weekly gatherings for young people: a lesson about Jesus Christ followed by games and food. Faith, friendship and fun.
